# Compatibility fixtures

`workspace-v1/` contains sanitized, immutable records generated by the actual
`investigation.Store` and `firewall.SampleASA` code exported from release merge
`d7d8299b2b8c7e014309d883c2413aef615332c8` (PR #12), using Go 1.25.14.
They were generated from that source, not by projecting the current evaluator.

One import followed by four TCP investigations, source `192.0.2.42:52000` to
`10.20.4.15`, yields permit on 443, explicit deny on 22, indeterminate on 8443,
and implicit deny on 80. Records use workspace-v1, parser `asa-config-v1`, and
policy-v2. Synthetic credentials are omitted from the sanitized source.

Tests copy the JSON files to a fresh private workspace and verify that current
code reads/replays them without changing their bytes, IDs or checksums. The
fixture directory is never opened directly as a mutable runtime workspace.
